name: Columbine Plastics Corp. Full Service Custom Injection Molding
old_description: Columbine Plastics will work with you to refine your design to reduce tooling or part costs and enhance manufacturing and repeatability. We are experts in materials and we have the most sophisticated prototyping capabilities in the industry.
about:
Columbine Plastics Corp. operates from Louisville, Colorado, as a custom injection molding and moldmaking specialist. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom plastic injection molding, precision moldmaking, laser sintering, and rapid tooling. Its moldmaking capabilities range from low-cost aluminum tools to multi-cavity hot runner, three-plate, and laser-sintered mold systems. Columbine works with exotic, difficult-to-run polymers such as PEEK and Ultem, and reports supplying over 100,000 components annually. An experienced quality assurance team reviews dimensional and cosmetic requirements before production.

Customers include industrial equipment manufacturers such as Caterpillar Tractor Company and high-technology suppliers like Litton Industries. The company serves sectors requiring critical high-technology components and precision replication for demanding applications.

Columbine emphasizes design collaboration to reduce tooling and part costs while improving manufacturability and repeatability. It positions its prototyping capabilities as among the most sophisticated in the industry and stresses consistent replication of precision parts at competitive pricing.
